cases.case: Backdated commit: dated in the window, pushed before it started
cases.reason: commit aaaaaaa is dated 2026-10-11T10:00:00Z but was pushed 2026-10-05 09:00 UTC, before the hackathon started

cases.case: Rebased branch: old author dates, committed and pushed in the window
cases.reason: Every matched commit was pushed after the hackathon started.

cases.case: Events API gap: no push events returned
cases.reason: No push events matched the commits, so we couldn't compare.

cases.case: Entire link to another team's repo
cases.reason: 1 point to a different repo than team/app.

cases.case: Entire + GitHub links to this repo (different case)
Demo video published before the hackathon
cases.reason: published 2026-08-30 12:00 UTC, before the hackathon started
The YouTube Data API didn't give a publish date (quota, private video or API off), so we couldn't confirm it.

cases.case: Same screenshot reused as two different traces
cases.reason: the same image is used as 2 different screenshots: docs/run1.png, docs/run2.png
Every evidence image exists, is a real image and is distinct.

cases.case: Rounded percentage: 106 s -> 36.7 s called '65% faster'
cases.reason: Every stated % or × matches its before and after numbers.

cases.case: Code dump: one commit adds 90% of the code
cases.reason: One commit (big0000, 2026-10-10 08:00 UTC) adds 18,000 lines, 90% of everything added.

cases.case: Template start mentioned in the README
cases.reason: Commit big0000 adds 90% of the lines, and the README says the project started from a template or existing code.

cases.case: X post from before the hackathon

cases.reason: All 1 are dated inside the hackathon window.

cases.case: Quoted checkpoint ID that isn't in the repo
cases.reason: 1 quoted ID(s) aren't in this repo's pushed checkpoint refs or commit trailers: 01ZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ

cases.case: Commits dated before the repo was created
cases.reason: 1 commit(s) are dated after the hackathon started but before this repo was created, e.g. aaaaaaa (2026-10-11T10:00:00Z).

cases.case: History moved from an older repo (said in the README)
cases.reason: Some commits predate the repo, and the README says the history was moved from another repo.
